title: Deliver signed repository events to generic HTTP endpoints
author: w0F5vYijNonu8kkqLSa_jYY4GIV-Q5HpbxYY525ggm4

events.title: Deliver signed repository events to generic HTTP endpoints
events.body:
## Outcome

Deliver bounded signed repository events to operator-configured HTTP consumers with reliable retry and privacy controls.

## Implementation

- Define a versioned envelope for push, issue, pull request, review, check, release, mirror, policy, and availability events.
- Support endpoint and event allowlists, secret references, signature rotation, and a verification challenge.
- Assign stable delivery identifiers and persist bounded retry, exponential backoff, cancellation, and dead-letter state.
- Redact or omit private repository payloads according to endpoint scope before signing the delivery envelope.
- Expose per-delivery status, attempts, next retry, response class, and replay action without storing response secrets.

## Acceptance criteria

- Duplicate attempts are idempotent at the fixture consumer.
- A failing endpoint cannot block repository writes or other endpoints.
- Private fields never reach a public-scoped endpoint.
- Retry and dead-letter storage are bounded by count, bytes, and age.
- Every delivered envelope verifies independently against its configured signer.

## Dependencies

Uses deterministic event records from #440; inbound checks and replayable streams are separate in #471.

## Verification

Run success, timeout, disconnect, retry-after, duplicate, invalid challenge, key rotation, private redaction, dead-letter, manual replay, and storage-bound fixtures.
